The '''''Parting Gift''''' was a small, heavily armored, twelve-passenger [[Sandalso]] [[LuxiCruiser]] [[Yacht/Legends|yacht]] in use in [[44 ABY]]. In that [[Standard year/Legends|year]], the new [[Imperial Remnant/Legends|Imperial Remnant]] [[Head of State/Legends|Head of State]] [[Vitor Reige]] gave it to the previous Head of State, [[Jagged Fel]] as a gift. Fel [[Pilot/Legends|flew]] it when he was called to pick up [[Captain/Legends|Captain]] [[Han Solo/Legends|Han Solo]], Solo's [[Marriage/Legends|wife]], [[Leia Organa Solo/Legends|Leia]], their granddaughter, [[Allana Djo Solo|Allana]], and their escorts&mdash;[[Jedi Knight/Legends|Jedi Knight]] [[Zekk]], the [[Hapan]] [[Taryn Zel]], and several [[Hapes Consortium/Legends|Hapan]] [[Commando/Legends|commandos]]&mdash;from the [[New Jedi Temple]]. The Solos had gone in with their escort to [[Assault on the New Jedi Temple|rescue]] the nest and [[Youngling/Legends|younglings]] of [[Barabel/Legends|Barabel]] [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] Knights [[Tesar Sebatyne]], [[Dordi]], [[Wilyem]], and [[Zal]]. Although several Hapans and some of the younglings were [[Death/Legends|killed]] as they fought the [[Lost Tribe of Sith|Sith forces]] that had occupied the Temple, the extraction was successful. On the mission, the ''Parting Gift'' also transported [[Jedi Master/Legends|Jedi Master]] [[Saba Sebatyne]] and former Jedi [[Tahiri Veila]], along with [[Void Jumper]] [[Master Sergeant/Legends|Master Sergeant]] [[Gef Olazon]] and a unit of his Void Jumper [[Galactic Alliance Marines|marines]] to the Temple. During the extraction, Master Sebatyne, Veila, Olazon, and the Void Jumpers entered the Temple to hunt down [[Abeloth]]&mdash;a [[Dark side of the Force/Legends|dark side]] [[The Ones/Legends|entity]] who had moved her presence into the Temple's [[Computer/Legends|computer]] core.
